newsitem.title: UK: Hague hot favourite to lead UK Conservatives.
newsitem.headline: Hague hot favourite to lead UK Conservatives.

text.p: Former Welsh secretary William Hague is hot favourite to become the new leader of the British Conservative party, which was routed in the May 1 election, a bookmaking firm said on Monday.
Ladbrokes said it had cut the odds on Hague winning to 4-7 from 4-5 after a rush of bets. The odds on second-favourite Peter Lilley are 5-1.
"Sunday newspaper reports suggest Hague has the backing of many of the existing Tory (Conservative) members of parliament," Ladbrokes spokesman Ed Nicholson said in a statement.
"That seems to have been the catalyst for betting activity across the country."
Michael Howard is offered at 11-2, with Kenneth Clark at 7-1, Stephen Dorrell at 12-1 and John Redwood at 14-1.
